texts.name: Kronos
texts.biography: King of the Titans and master of time. Imprisoned in the depths of Tartarus, he still awaits the hour of his return.

specialty.name: Master of Time
specialty.description:
In the Titan Cycle, Time stays ascendant for two rounds in a row (Sky, Time, Time, Earth). Slow is cast with increased effect, based on the hero's level.

{Patron God: Kronos}: Time Aspect troops under the hero Timelock their target at 2 stacks of Time Lag.
{Affinity}: god powers of Kronos are stronger in the hero's hands; see each spell.

texts.name: Leto
texts.biography: A Titaness, guardian of the Automaton Warriors. Her creations repair one another after they fall.

specialty.name: Favor: Automata
specialty.description:
Gains 1 Favor at the start of each round and receives a boon at each mark:
{2 Favor}: Automaton Warriors gain Divinity for 2 rounds.
{4 Favor}: Automaton Warriors are repaired to full Hit Points.
{7 Favor}: All enemy troops get +1 stack of Time Lag.

{Patron God: Kronos}: Time Aspect troops under the hero Timelock their target at 2 stacks of Time Lag.
{Affinity}: god powers of Kronos are stronger in the hero's hands; see each spell.

texts.name: Rheia
texts.biography: Wife of Kronos and mother of the gods. In her hands the favor of the faithful never runs dry.

specialty.name: +1 Crystal
specialty.description:
Gives the kingdom an extra 1 Crystal each day.

{Patron God: Kronos}: Time Aspect troops under the hero Timelock their target at 2 stacks of Time Lag.
{Affinity}: god powers of Kronos are stronger in the hero's hands; see each spell.

texts.name: Atlas the Skybearer
texts.biography: The Titan condemned to hold up the sky. Beside him, nothing can be shaken.

specialty.name: Favor: Titans
specialty.description:
Gains 1 Favor at the start of each round and receives a boon at each mark:
{2 Favor}: Lava Titans gain Divinity for 2 rounds.
{4 Favor}: Skybearer: Lava Titans take 50% less damage this round.
{7 Favor}: All enemy troops get +1 stack of Time Lag.

{Patron God: Kronos}: Time Aspect troops under the hero Timelock their target at 2 stacks of Time Lag.
{Affinity}: god powers of Kronos are stronger in the hero's hands; see each spell.

texts.name: Krios
texts.biography: The Theocrat of Atlantis and servant of Kronos, who brought the worship of the Titans back to his homeland with his own hands.

specialty.name: Favor: Arcus
specialty.description:
Gains 1 Favor at the start of each round and receives a boon at each mark:
{2 Favor}: Arcus gain Divinity for 2 rounds.
{4 Favor}: Starpath: Arcus attack one more time this round.
{7 Favor}: All enemy troops get +1 stack of Time Lag.

{Patron God: Kronos}: Time Aspect troops under the hero Timelock their target at 2 stacks of Time Lag.
{Affinity}: god powers of Kronos are stronger in the hero's hands; see each spell.

texts.name: Mestor
texts.biography: One of the ten kings of Atlantis recorded by Plato, famed for his siege engines.

specialty.name: Archery
specialty.description:
Receives a 5% per level bonus to the Archery skill percentage.

{Patron God: Kronos}: Time Aspect troops under the hero Timelock their target at 2 stacks of Time Lag.
{Affinity}: god powers of Kronos are stronger in the hero's hands; see each spell.

texts.name: Euaemon
texts.biography: One of the ten kings, commander of the heavy infantry of the kingdom.

specialty.name: Offense
specialty.description:
Receives a 5% per level bonus to the Offense skill percentage.

{Patron God: Kronos}: Time Aspect troops under the hero Timelock their target at 2 stacks of Time Lag.
{Affinity}: god powers of Kronos are stronger in the hero's hands; see each spell.

texts.name: Mneseus
texts.biography: One of the ten kings, the general who guards the walls of the inner ring.

specialty.name: Armorer
specialty.description:
Receives a 5% per level bonus to the Armorer skill percentage.

{Patron God: Kronos}: Time Aspect troops under the hero Timelock their target at 2 stacks of Time Lag.
{Affinity}: god powers of Kronos are stronger in the hero's hands; see each spell.

texts.name: Oranos
texts.biography: The primordial god of the sky. All things lie beneath his gaze.

specialty.name: Sky Father
specialty.description:
In rounds of the Titan Cycle when Sky is ascendant, all Aspect troops under the hero get +1 Luck and +1 Speed. Haste is cast with increased effect, based on the hero's level.

{Patron God: Oranos}: Sky Eye marked by Sky Aspect troops under the hero lasts 3 rounds.
{Affinity}: god powers of Oranos are stronger in the hero's hands; see each spell.

texts.name: Prometheus
texts.biography: The Titan who stole fire from heaven for mortals. Under his command, mortals too can become heroes.

specialty.name: Fire Thief
specialty.description:
Troops under the hero gain +25% stack experience. Receives a 5% per level bonus to the Learning skill percentage.

{Patron God: Oranos}: Sky Eye marked by Sky Aspect troops under the hero lasts 3 rounds.
{Affinity}: god powers of Oranos are stronger in the hero's hands; see each spell.

texts.name: Hyperion
texts.biography: The Titan of heavenly light. The Nereids follow him on his rounds of the four seas.

specialty.name: Favor: Nereids
specialty.description:
Gains 1 Favor at the start of each round and receives a boon at each mark:
{2 Favor}: Nereids gain Divinity for 2 rounds.
{4 Favor}: Radiance: Nereids are fully charged at once (next melee attack deals +200% damage).
{7 Favor}: Shockwave: all enemy troops get -2 Speed for 2 rounds.

{Patron God: Oranos}: Sky Eye marked by Sky Aspect troops under the hero lasts 3 rounds.
{Affinity}: god powers of Oranos are stronger in the hero's hands; see each spell.

texts.name: Helios
texts.biography: The sun god who drives the chariot of the sun. The Centimani keep watch over the heavens for him.

specialty.name: Favor: Centimani
specialty.description:
Gains 1 Favor at the start of each round and receives a boon at each mark:
{2 Favor}: Centimani gain Divinity for 2 rounds.
{4 Favor}: Blazing Sun: Centimani deal +25% damage for 2 rounds.
{7 Favor}: Shockwave: all enemy troops get -2 Speed for 2 rounds.

{Patron God: Oranos}: Sky Eye marked by Sky Aspect troops under the hero lasts 3 rounds.
{Affinity}: god powers of Oranos are stronger in the hero's hands; see each spell.

texts.name: Theocrat
texts.biography: The high priest who urged the people to turn to Oranos. His words can lift the spirits of a whole army.

specialty.name: Prayer Master
specialty.description:
Prayer is cast with increased effect, based on the hero's level: the lower the level of the target creature, the greater the increase.

{Patron God: Oranos}: Sky Eye marked by Sky Aspect troops under the hero lasts 3 rounds.
{Affinity}: god powers of Oranos are stronger in the hero's hands; see each spell.

texts.name: Ampheres
texts.biography: One of the ten kings, master of the fleets in the harbors of the outer ring.

specialty.name: Navigation
specialty.description:
Receives a 5% per level bonus to the Navigation skill percentage.

{Patron God: Oranos}: Sky Eye marked by Sky Aspect troops under the hero lasts 3 rounds.
{Affinity}: god powers of Oranos are stronger in the hero's hands; see each spell.

texts.name: Autochthon
texts.biography: One of the ten kings, a man born of the earth who knows every road in the kingdom.

specialty.name: Logistics
specialty.description:
Receives a 5% per level bonus to the Logistics skill percentage.

{Patron God: Oranos}: Sky Eye marked by Sky Aspect troops under the hero lasts 3 rounds.
{Affinity}: god powers of Oranos are stronger in the hero's hands; see each spell.

texts.name: Elasippus
texts.biography: One of the ten kings, named "the Horse-Driver", who leads the Turmae in person.

specialty.name: Turmae
specialty.description:
Increases the Attack and Defense of Turmae and their upgrades by 20% for every 3 levels. They also get +1 Speed. Can convert Automaton Warriors and Turmae into each other at any time from the creature window (paying the price difference).

{Patron God: Oranos}: Sky Eye marked by Sky Aspect troops under the hero lasts 3 rounds.
{Affinity}: god powers of Oranos are stronger in the hero's hands; see each spell.

texts.name: King Atlas
texts.biography: Eldest son of Poseidon and first king of Atlantis, for whom the ocean is named.

specialty.name: Estates
specialty.description:
Receives a 5% per level bonus to the Estates skill percentage.

{Patron God: Oranos}: Sky Eye marked by Sky Aspect troops under the hero lasts 3 rounds.
{Affinity}: god powers of Oranos are stronger in the hero's hands; see each spell.

texts.name: Gaia
texts.biography: Mother Earth. Grass and trees spring up by themselves beneath her people's feet.

specialty.name: Mother Earth
specialty.description:
In rounds of the Titan Cycle when Earth is ascendant, all Aspect troops under the hero get +2 Defense and recover 5% of their Hit Points. Cure is cast with increased effect, based on the hero's level.

{Patron God: Gaia}: Lush Ground heals 15% per round.
{Affinity}: god powers of Gaia are stronger in the hero's hands; see each spell.

texts.name: Oceanus
texts.biography: God of the great river that encircles the world. The Caladrias heal the wounded in his name.

specialty.name: Favor: Caladrias
specialty.description:
Gains 1 Favor at the start of each round and receives a boon at each mark:
{2 Favor}: Caladrias gain Divinity for 2 rounds.
{4 Favor}: Tidal Surge: all friendly living troops recover 20% of their Hit Points.
{7 Favor}: Lush Ground grows under all friendly troops.

{Patron God: Gaia}: Lush Ground heals 15% per round.
{Affinity}: god powers of Gaia are stronger in the hero's hands; see each spell.

texts.name: Theia
texts.biography: The Titaness of sight and radiance, who makes clear the eyes of the seers.

specialty.name: Scouting
specialty.tooltip: Special Bonus: scouting radius grows with level
specialty.description:
Scouting radius grows with level: +1 at level 2, +2 at level 8, +3 at level 14, then another +1 about every 6-7 levels.

{Patron God: Gaia}: Lush Ground heals 15% per round.
{Affinity}: god powers of Gaia are stronger in the hero's hands; see each spell.

texts.name: Hekate
texts.biography: Goddess of magic and crossroads; the gates of the underworld obey her command.

specialty.name: Tartarian Gate
specialty.description:
Starts with Tartarian Gate, and its damage and summoned amount are increased by 50% (instead of the +25% from Affinity). Receives a 5% per level bonus to the Sorcery skill percentage.

{Patron God: Gaia}: Lush Ground heals 15% per round.
{Affinity}: god powers of Gaia are stronger in the hero's hands; see each spell.

texts.name: Kastor
texts.biography: Son of Arkantos, the young leader of the survivors of Atlantis.

specialty.name: Favor: Murmillos
specialty.description:
Gains 1 Favor at the start of each round and receives a boon at each mark:
{2 Favor}: Murmillos gain Divinity for 2 rounds.
{4 Favor}: Hero's Will: Murmillos get +4 Attack and +4 Defense for 2 rounds.
{7 Favor}: Lush Ground grows under all friendly troops.

{Patron God: Gaia}: Lush Ground heals 15% per round.
{Affinity}: god powers of Gaia are stronger in the hero's hands; see each spell.

texts.name: Gadeirus
texts.biography: One of the ten kings, also called Eumelus. His domain reaches the Pillars of Heracles, and his wealth has no equal.

specialty.name: +350 Gold
specialty.description:
Gives the kingdom an extra 350 gold each day.

{Patron God: Gaia}: Lush Ground heals 15% per round.
{Affinity}: god powers of Gaia are stronger in the hero's hands; see each spell.

texts.name: Azaes
texts.biography: One of the ten kings, who presides over the rites in the temple of Poseidon.

specialty.name: Mysticism
specialty.description:
Receives a 5% per level bonus to the Mysticism skill percentage.

{Patron God: Gaia}: Lush Ground heals 15% per round.
{Affinity}: god powers of Gaia are stronger in the hero's hands; see each spell.

texts.name: Diaprepes
texts.biography: One of the ten kings, named "the Illustrious", keeper of the laws of the kingdom.

specialty.name: Intelligence
specialty.description:
Receives a 5% per level bonus to the Intelligence skill percentage.

{Patron God: Gaia}: Lush Ground heals 15% per round.
{Affinity}: god powers of Gaia are stronger in the hero's hands; see each spell.
